evidence.reason: The dependency scan is intended to catch [Unit] directives on co-installed units that affect the selected service, including start/stop relationships. `DEPENDENCY_RE` includes other dependency directives but omits systemd v257 `PropagatesStopTo=` and its inverse `StopPropagatedFrom=`, so a co-installed unit can stop the selected service while discovery still reports it supported. This is an ordinary regex-completeness bug in existing behavior; adding both alternatives is the smallest fix.
